Qualification rules & updates

An app qualifies when it appears today and its App ID was absent from every successfully recorded monitored category during the previous 30 calendar days. The comparison is cross-category, so changing categories does not make an app new.

Tracking starts with the September 28 baseline. Earlier unrecorded days count as no appearance, so the first list on September 29 compares directly with September 28. Only the latest 30 daily records are retained. An app can qualify again after 30 full days without a recorded appearance.

All eight charts must be collected to publish a daily list. Partial days publish no leads, but any App IDs successfully observed still prevent false requalification during the rolling window.

Updates run automatically around 09:00 Europe/Rome; a run may start a few minutes late. Always check the snapshot date. All team members share the same monitoring scope.

Source: Apple’s public category charts. App Store links provide current app details.
